item.title: Furukawa Electric to invest JPY100 billion to double rollable ribbon cable capacity in response to data center demand
item.summary: Furukawa Electric said on August 4 that it will invest approximately JPY100 billion (approx.US$630 million) in total to expand production capacity for optical fibers and optical fiber cables, citing sustained growth in demand for high-quality optical fiber cables driven by hyperscale data center buildouts.
